source: Written 2026-11-13 from the two sources the operator supplied, both read directly: (1) the Agents Library SharePoint share, 16 project folders, walked in full — file names, sizes and the real pixel dimensions of the largest render in each folder were measured, not inferred; (2) the master price list at domoproperties.com/mp, which is a Framer page whose actual document is a 33-page PDF on framerusercontent.com, published 12 Nov 2026. Project areas come from the portfolio map on pages 4-5 of that PDF. Company details from the site footer: A.H. DOMO Properties Ltd, Reg. No HE 427856, Vasili Vryonidi 1, 3095 Limassol, +357 70001211.

account.notes:
SOURCE OF TRUTH, two of them, deliberately split:

1. UNITS AND PRICES come from the master price list at domoproperties.com/mp and from nowhere else. Every project folder in the share also holds an 'Unbranded_<project>_brochure with prices_<date>.pdf', and those are NOT used for figures: they are dated between 12 Aug and 10 Nov 2026 while the master list is 12 Nov, and two price sources for one unit is a way to be wrong twice rather than a cross-check. The brochures are read for descriptive copy only.

2. MEDIA comes from the SharePoint share, one folder per project. The link is a bearer credential (anonymous 'anyone with the link' access, no sign-in) and is therefore kept ONLY in DeveloperAccount.developerCloudUrl, never in this repo — same rule as Korantina, PDOM and Patroclos. Pass it once via DOMO_CLOUD_URL when running the sync, or set it in the admin.

SCOPE. 18 projects are on sale: 15 residential and 3 commercial. The share has 16 folders; THE GLOVER and ROMAN HOUSE are in the price list with no folder at all, so they have prices and no pictures — they are listed here so they are not forgotten, and they cannot get a usable page until DOMO sends material.

RENAMES. Five projects were renamed and their FILES still carry the old studio names: Messina was Alveo, Milford Heights was Seya, Navarre was Vireo, Padua was Orien, Mantua was Caeli. Identity here comes from the FOLDER, never from a file name, and the old names must not reach alt text or public file names.

SHARED RENDERS. Messina and Padua carry the same five interior renders, identical by MD5, not merely similar. The sync gives them to the first project in this file's order and skips them for the second; see claimPhoto in src/lib/domo/media.ts.

THIN MATERIAL. Albion, Arden and Avon have ONE render each and Blackfriars House has none. That is not enough for a project page that sells; it needs to be requested from DOMO.

COMPLETION DATES (phase 2, 2026-11-14). Every price-list page carries a 'Delivery: Qn YYYY' line, and on 11 of the 24 pages the text layer yields TWO of them with different quarters. They are not two phases: the second is the designer's previous header, left in the file and painted over by the black band, so only one is visible. The visible one is the line left-aligned with the page's own title (x=23.2 on every page); the stale copies sit 3 to 17pt away or on another line. All 24 pages were rendered and read by eye on 2026-11-14 to confirm the rule picks what a human sees. src/lib/domo/priceList.ts reads it, domoPriceList.test.ts carries the three real traps (Siena, Aalto, Liora), and a page whose band stops matching the template yields no date at all rather than a guess.
